title: Builder Pattern
summary: Construct complex objects step by step using method chaining.
lecture: The builder pattern decouples object construction from representation. It allows setting optional or required parameters incrementally before creating the final struct.
In Rust, builders can leverage typestates or Option fields to validate that all required data is provided at compile time or runtime.
Consuming self in builder methods enables fluent method chaining without unnecessary copies.

example.caption: Chaining builder methods to construct a client.
